ownerTodos: Send your service list and prices. Without them there is no services page and the cost question cannot be answered.
Send photos: the shop front, the room, and three or four finished cuts.
Confirm your barbers' names if you want them on the site, and whether customers can request one.
Confirm whether you take appointments at all, or walk-in only.
If you have Instagram, send the handle so it can be linked.
claimsAvoided: No services page. The reviews praise the barbers, not a list of services, so there is no evidence for one. Cuts, beard work and prices would all have been guesses.
No prices. One review says the prices are good, which is an opinion about prices, not a price.
No barber named. Four reviews name what appear to be four different barbers; a wrong or departed name on the homepage is worse than none.
No founding year or 'serving Jacksonville since'. A review mentions a nine-year relationship with a barber, which says nothing about when this shop opened.
No testimonials or review quotes. Review text is research, not copy.
No email, booking link, or social profiles. Google lists none and none were found.
